strategies.name: DSR Momentum Breakout
strategies.description: Trades breakouts from daily support/resistance zones using momentum confirmation on H1 timeframe.
strategies.entryLogic: Price breaks above/below DSR zone with RSI > 60 (long) or < 40 (short). Volume confirmation required.
strategies.exitLogic: TP at 1:2 RR from entry. SL below/above DSR zone. Trail stop after 1:1 reached.
